title: Number of Business Closures and Formations since Start of Circuit Breaker
what_it_is: Number of Business Closures and Formations since Start of Circuit Breaker

sections.label: COVID-19 impact on business entities
sections.summary: Business entity formation fell almost a third below the 2015-2019 average, while April cessations of about 3,800 were comparable to the five-year average of 3,700.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, this was almost a third lower than the average of 5,500 recorded over the same period between 2015 and 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The cessation of business entities numbered around 3,800 in April, which was comparable to the average of 3,700 recorded over the same month in the past five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For the rest of 2020, the COVID-19 pandemic is expected to have a severe impact on many sectors of our economy.

sections.label: MTI expects subdued business formation
sections.summary: MTI expects new business entity formation to remain subdued while cessation numbers could rise in coming months.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Against this backdrop, MTI expects the formation of new business entities to remain subdued, while cessation numbers could see an uptick in the coming months.

sections.label: SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package
sections.summary: The council aims to support close to 100,000 jobseekers through the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The council aims to support close to 100,000 jobseekers through the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package.

sections.label: EDB investment commitments
sections.summary: Minister Chan Chun Sing said EDB attracted $13 billion in investment commitments, which will create thousands of jobs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Minister Chan Chun Sing shared earlier this week that the investment commitments that EDB has managed to attract amounted to $13 billion and this will create thousands of jobs.

sections.label: Adapting to attract growth sectors
sections.summary: The passage calls for adapting quickly and flexibly to attract growth sectors such as agri-tech, biomedical, e-commerce, financial, infocomm and technology to grow the pie.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: How we navigate in this new COVID-19 environment, how we are able to adapt, how quickly and how flexible we can be to adjust to attract new growth sectors – agri-tech, biomedical, e-commerce, financial sector, infocomm and technology – those are the areas which we have to work together to be able to grow the pie so that there is more to go around; better jobs, more jobs, more opportunities.
